title: Figure 16. Conceptual SNR Fill Factors: Signal and Noise Components
description: Diagram headed "Signal to noise ratios (SNR's) at the transmitter and at the receiver must be calculated to support a communications link design." It shows stacked bars for "Predicted SNR Components at the Transmitter" (GW Xmit Signal, GW Source Noise, EM to GW Conversion Noise, EM Source Noise) connected by a "1/R² Loss" link to "Predicted SNR Components at the Receiver" (GW Signal Rcv'd, GW Antenna & Receiver Noise, GW to EM Conversion Noise, EM Receiver Noise). Text continues into section "3.1.2 Link Budget Considerations".
